name: Shadowshard Fragments
label: Quest
description: Shadowshard Fragments: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Strong magics be found in the centaur holy place... The holy place of Maraudon. The Desolace tribes of centaur protect that place wit' their lives, but they canna stop us from takin' what we need.
You, you head to this Maraudon place and find the rock creatures made of shadowshard. You bring me the purple crystals, and Uthel'nay make you somethin' for your time.
The place be dangerous, so maybe you be bringing some friends.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You find the crystals yet? Rituals of power, spells of great strength--those shadowshards maybe very helpful in all kind of arcane magics.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, these be perfect for me magics. Here, you take one of these trinkets and be on your way... Me got much studyin' to do.
